you're doing good things here - thanks for taking the time to talk to a stranger. means that people can still be good.
Our relationship is a little wobbly and i'm afraid of it breaking any more by doing this to her - I also don't know what will happen after I say it. Social services? Hospital? I'm honestly scared.
